questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Publicis and/or LiveRamp.

Describe what data ingestion and unification (or closely related) services your organisation acquires and how the services are procured, including whether your organisation procures these services independently or in combination with other products, and whether you acquire these services from a single provider or multiple.

In the event that LiveRamp’s services were only available when used with other related Publicis services, would this affect your choice of provider for the other related services? Please explain why/why not.
What would be involved in switching your data ingestion and unification services provider? Please consider factors such as costs to switch, data ownership, and data interoperability/neutrality.

questions.section: Questions to ad-tech providers and advertising agencies
questions.text: If LiveRamp were to make changes to access, integration, or interoperability, how would this impact your usage of its services? For instance, would you use a competitor?

questions.section: Questions to ad-tech providers and advertising agencies
questions.text: Do you consider that changes to access, integration, or interoperability in LiveRamp’s data unification and ingestion services could materially affect your ability to compete and provide the services you currently offer? Please explain why/why not.
